sandboxes that restrict what our agents can access and execute, lightweight virtual machines (microVMs) that isolate agents’ execution environments from the computers hosting them, monitoring systems that detect unauthorized activity so that we can intervene in time, and network and cloud perimeters designed to maintain containment if all the preceding controls fail.
